story_zh: 今天是十月八号，星期天，是小明的生日。去年他的生日在星期三。今天早上八点，他吃了蛋糕。中午十二点，他和朋友一起玩。下午三点，他们看电影。晚上七点，他们吃晚饭。现在九点了，小明很开心。明天是星期一，他要上学。
story_pinyin: Jīntiān shì shí yuè bā hào, xīngqītiān, shì Xiǎo Míng de shēngrì. Qùnián tā de shēngrì zài xīngqīsān. Jīntiān zǎoshang bā diǎn, tā chī le dàngāo. Zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn, tā hé péngyou yīqǐ wán. Xiàwǔ sān diǎn, tāmen kàn diànyǐng. Wǎnshang qī diǎn, tāmen chī wǎnfàn. Xiànzài jiǔ diǎn le, Xiǎo Míng hěn kāixīn. Míngtiān shì xīngqīyī, tā yào shàngxué.
story_en: Today is October 8th, Sunday, and it's Xiao Ming's birthday. Last year his birthday was on Wednesday. This morning at eight o'clock, he ate cake. At noon twelve o'clock, he played with friends. At three o'clock in the afternoon, they watched a movie. At seven o'clock in the evening, they had dinner. Now it's nine o'clock, and Xiao Ming is very happy. Tomorrow is Monday, and he has to go to school.
